A '''holograph message plaque''' was a device that stored and [[Holoprojector/Legends|played]] [[Hologram/Legends|hologrammic]] and [[holograph]]ic messages. [[Skorr/Legends|Skorr]] used one to as part of a scheme to capture [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]].
